name: smwgraphics-super-wagyan-land-2-stage
title: Super Wagyan Land 2 - Stage 1
description:
WARNING: This background will override the vanilla ground palette, thus requiring to use a different palette for the ground.

This is the Stage 1 BG from the Japan-exclusive Super Famicom game Super Wagyan Land 2.
Ripped with Racing Stripe and The Ultimate Background Ripping Tool.
Good for Grassland levels.
